name: Yd11 transformer connection reference
aliases: Yd11 transformer connection reference IEC reference
summary: This reference identifies the publisher's Yd11 transformer connection form with star/delta winding topology.
description: Yd11 combines an HV-side star winding designation with an LV-side delta designation and clock group 11. The letters describe connection topology; the final number identifies the phase relationship recorded with the transformer connection diagram. It is different from the voltage ratio or the number of terminals.

A drafter should preserve the full Yd11 designation across the SLD, transformer schedule and protection references. Two devices with the same winding letters but a different clock number are not the same connection reference. Check the selected transformer terminal diagram and the protection application documentation; the concept preview does not specify polarity tests, parallel-operation suitability or relay settings.
readingNotes: Preserve the full group notation and verify the terminal/phase relationship in the selected transformer diagram.
